name: Add recruiting's parameters and the founder stage to the mechanism reset
text_content:
Type: process

Session 4 placed the mechanism reset after dinner's first quarter, after the first full year, then annually, reading every mechanism against its record, cost, and buy. Recruiting hands it four things. The founder stage: pre-opening it is the last scored stage for every seat, and the team's recommendation for the reset is that it ends for edge seats and continues for lead seats permanently, since the leads are the center's peers and their dinner in the room already has the partners at the table; the reset ratifies that against the stage's own record (P53, P54, I13). The response window is a parameter of the reset and not a law (P29). The candidate pulse's monthly reads feed it (I16). And every recruiting instrument names the reset as its revision rhythm, so the reset is where the seat sheet, the scorecards, the answer set, the pool tag, the referral record, the pipeline read, and the decision-rights entries are re-read (section 14). The process to design is what recruiting's section of the reset agenda contains and what evidence each line opens on.

Filed by Session 5 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhm4. Reasoning lives on the S5 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text:
Extended. Two more parameter sets join the reset's list from Session 9: the recurrence thresholds (three consecutive leads' reviews, two consecutive quarterly lines after a fix, a quarter of every service for a designation, and the domain-repeat rules), all in counts of reviews and services; and the career conversation's length, set at thirty minutes to start. Both are re-set against their own record, and none is ever set in money.
